reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: UUID4 hexadecimal string generated by Tool_SqliteTaskStore.
reviewed_decisions.limit: Global uniqueness and collision recovery are not formally proven or fault-injected.

reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: Entity_Task constructs immutable ValueObject_TaskTitle before insertion and on hydration.
reviewed_decisions.limit: Language-specific character length is Python str length; no alternative Unicode normalization is promised.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Canonical intrinsic validity belongs to entity construction/behavior.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: Persistence accepts a ready Task for saving; raw values and rows use canonical construction.
reviewed_decisions.limit: Contextual presence checks do not replace or duplicate intrinsic validation.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Insertion order; failure is distinct from an empty collection.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: ORDER BY rowid, canonical hydration, propagated storage exceptions.
reviewed_decisions.limit: The test uses two controlled identifiers in reverse lexical order and a simulated connection failure; no exhaustive storage-failure proof.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Idempotent observed result, with stable identity/title and completed true.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: The case skips save when the fetched entity is already completed.
reviewed_decisions.limit: The L1 contract does not require avoiding every low-level update. No optimistic revision or distributed concurrency protocol is specified.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Each case denies absent, unresolved, unknown or insufficient actor context before protected operations.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: Frozen context entity resolved from configured local credentials; explicit case checks precede capability calls.
reviewed_decisions.limit: The in-process caller is trusted by the example. Demonstration tokens do not establish production identity infrastructure.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Do not infer absence of effects or safe retry solely from a failed write result.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: SQLite transaction and explicit connection closing per operation; failures propagate.
reviewed_decisions.limit: Connection failures are mocked before access. Ambiguous commit, crash recovery, retries and distributed writes are not simulated.

reviewed_decisions.source_contract: Public operation and representation mapping are identified separately from domain cases.
reviewed_decisions.selected_realization: LegacyReports calls TaskBoard HTTP with a read credential; no private import or shared database.
reviewed_decisions.limit: Interaction decisions remain L4 even under Shared documentation or boundaries code.

review_findings_addressed.issue: Qualified Python check symbol could be accepted under the wrong class.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Resolve the declared hierarchy and reject a same-named method in another class.
review_findings_addressed.regression_owner: Minerva validator tests; final run recorded separately.

review_findings_addressed.issue: A selected app symlink outside the assessment root could be skipped and still pass.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Emit an invalid-scope diagnostic instead of silently accepting zero evaluated sources.

review_findings_addressed.issue: CLI denied-completion scenario pointed at a test exercising only denied creation.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Exercise actual CLI complete with demo-reader, verify exit 3, forbidden stderr and unchanged pending task.

review_findings_addressed.issue: List ordering scenario described two tasks but the test used one.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Use two generated IDs in reverse lexical order and assert insertion order.

review_findings_addressed.issue: List storage-failure clause lacked a matching failure observation.
review_findings_addressed.resolution: Assert sqlite3.OperationalError for list under a mocked unavailable connection and link the storage-failure scenario.

explicit_limits: This review is not stakeholder approval or formal proof of semantic equivalence.
The teaching Atlas source was reconstructed for this example. It is not DOC-TASK-BOARD from the published Atlas repository.
No generator or deterministic transformation engine from arbitrary Atlas input to code is supplied.
The Minerva distribution carries the model and source observations; the runnable realization and its tests are in the Vulcan distribution.
No hosted GitHub CI, C/Go execution, Docker execution, real-browser end-to-end test, production identity, load or distributed recovery run is claimed.
